summary: 1 errors, 66 minor. Main points: Book 4 glossary alignment (daṇḍa = penalty, vadha = killing, śuddha-vadha = plain killing, citra ghāta = varied killing, bare madhyama/uttama), subject of kuryāt bracketed, Hindi फिर भी -> फिर से (unit 15), उच्चार -> मलत्याग (21), शासन/मुद्रा -> आदेश/मुहर (12), utkoṭayati kept untranslated (23). No regrouping suggested. Cannot patch (need a person): add text_flags for 9 stray space 'vā- ā.catuṣ.paṇa' and catuṣ.paṇa vs catuṣpaṇa (4 vs 9); two identical w entries 'daṇḍaḥ' in unit 23 and 'vadhaḥ' in unit 27 keep gloss 'fine'/'death' (should be penalty/killing). Drafter's 7 flags are sound (unit 9 five visarga-h typos, stray 'it', probable dittography of 'gomaya.bhasmanā vā pralipya-avaghoṣaṇam' after the nine-paṇa range; unit 4 ā.pāda is only possible, parallel ranges mark ā.). Units 5, 10, 11 literal 'of half/a fourth part of the values' accepted; bracketed supplied words accepted (Hindi supplies them unbracketed). Draft is an unreviewed AI draft.
